WITH , , device_filter_contract_keys AS (
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(d.contract_no AS BINARY) AS contract_key FROM ast_device d
WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND d.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND d.contract_no <> ''
SELECT NULL AS contract_key WHERE 1 = 0 ), , visible_direct_projects AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.project_id FROM ast_device d
JOIN visible_projects vp ON vp.project_id = d.project_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND d.project_id IS NOT NULL
), visible_related_devices AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.device_sn FROM ast_device_project_relationship r JOIN visible_projects vp ON vp.project_id = r.project_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.deleted = b'0' AND r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND r.device_sn = #{query.sn} UNION SELECT DISTINCT ps.device_sn FROM project_list_entries ps JOIN visible_projects vp ON vp.project_id=ps.project_id WHERE ps.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND ps.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND (ps.device_sn=#{query.sn} OR ps.physical_sn=#{query.sn}) ), device_totals AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ast_device d
WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0'
), device_page AS ( SELECT FROM ast_device d
LEFT JOIN ast_device_network_version nv ON nv.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND nv.device_sn = d.sn AND nv.deleted = b'0' AND nv.source_system = 'DEVICE_LOG' AND (nv.sync_status IS NULL OR nv.sync_status <> 'NOT_AVAILABLE') WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0'
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize} ), page_device_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sn FROM device_page ), renewal_counts AS ( SELECT wr.tenant_id, wr.device_sn, COUNT(*) AS extended_count FROM page_device_keys k JOIN ast_device_warranty_record wr ON wr.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND wr.device_sn = k.sn WHERE wr.deleted = b'0' AND wr.extended = b'1' GROUP BY wr.tenant_id, wr.device_sn ) SELECT p.*, COALESCE(rc.extended_count, 0) AS extended_count, totals.total FROM device_totals totals LEFT JOIN device_page p ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN renewal_counts rc ON rc.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND rc.device_sn = p.sn ORDER BY p.device_id DESC
